[[File:Cook (Lumbridge) chathead.png|left]]
The '''cook''' is the head cook of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. He usually seems unprepared, but with the player's help, he prepares great food. He is the starting point for the [[Cook's Assistant]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]] [[quests]]. He can be found in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.

When the Cook's Assistant quest is completed, the player is granted use of [[Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)|his special range]], which has a lower chance of burning certain [[food]]s compared to other [[range]]s.
{{clear|left}}

==Treasure Trails==
* {{Anagram|The cook|medium|[[Clue scroll (medium) - OK CO|OK CO]]}}. He will present the player with a challenge scroll which asks, ''"How many cannons does Lumbridge Castle have?"'', the answer to which is 9. <br/>
* {{CrypticNPC|The cook|beginner|[[Clue scroll (beginner) - In the place Duke Horacio calls home|In the place Duke Horacio calls home, talk to a man with a hat dropped by goblins.]]}}

==Trivia==
[[File:Lumbridge Cook recipe book.png|thumb|right|The Cook's recipe book as seen in the [[20th Anniversary event]].]]
* According to the Cook, he has a wife,{{CiteNPC|npc=Cook (Lumbridge)|quote=My wife gets sea sick, and I have an irrational fear of eyepatches.|loc=Cook's Assistant}} four children, and a goat.{{CiteNPC|npc=Cook (Lumbridge)|quote=What will I do? I have four children and a goat to look after.|loc=Cook's Assistant}} However, [[Bob (cat)|Bob the cat]] claims the Cook doesn't have any children.{{CiteNPC|npc=Bob (cat)|quote=But this might be the last generation since the Duke's current cook doesn't have any children.}}
** During the [[2014 Valentine's Day event]], the Cook claimed he has a girlfriend.{{CiteNPC|npc=Cook (Lumbridge)|quote=I had plans for something, a little different for my girlfriend this year.|loc=2014 Valentine's Day event}} It is unknown if this woman eventually became his wife or if he is having an affair.
** As the Cook will also tell [[Zanik]] that it's the Duke's birthday and he needs help baking a cake when bringing her to visit him during [[Death to the Dorgeshuun]], it is likely he was lying not only about that, but also having a wife and 4 kids, to guilt people into helping him. This would resolve the inconsistencies between the various claims, meaning the truth is that he has a girlfriend and no kids.
* Bob the cat is a fan of the Cook's old fashioned seafood gumbo, which is an old family recipe, though Bob stops the player from asking for the recipe because the Cook is "very sensitive about his gumbo responsibilities".{{CiteNPC|npc=Bob (cat)|quote=[Player: Ah, I will have to ask him for the recipe then.] Oh, I wouldn't do that if I were you, he's very sensitive about his gumbo responsibilities.}}
** In the 8th [[Postbag from the Hedge]], Bob reveals that the Cook doesn't even know what gumbo is or how to cook it, but he suspects the recipe is hidden somewhere.{{CitePostbag|issue=8|author=Bob (cat)|letter=7|name=}}
* In the [[20th Anniversary event]], the Cook's recipe book is shown to be extremely crude. The Cook also admits to having burnt every single cake he ever attempted to bake in his life, explaining his constant need to ask adventurers to get him ingredients.{{CiteNPC|npc=Cook (Lumbridge)|quote=I've tried this recipe so many times, you know. One day I'll get it right - so far, all the cakes just burn, so I have to send another adventurer to fetch more ingredients.|loc=20th Anniversary event}}
* The Cook was one of the seven NPCs players had to bring specific items to during the [[2013 Rare Drops]] Cracker Jack clue hunt. He would reward the player with a [[Christmas cracker]] in exchange for two [[chef's hat]]s, two [[white apron]]s, and twelve [[knife|knives]].
